title: Simply Healthcare
shortDescription: Florida Medicaid and Medicare plans from an Elevance Health company, operating statewide.
description:
Simply Healthcare Plans is a Florida-based health plan and a subsidiary of Elevance Health, the company formerly known as Anthem. It focuses on government-sponsored coverage — Florida Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and Florida Healthy Kids — rather than commercial employer plans.

Under the 2025-2030 Statewide Medicaid Managed Care contracts, Simply was selected to serve Florida Medicaid members statewide, including as a specialty plan for members with HIV/AIDS and for members with serious mental illness. It was also awarded a statewide Florida Healthy Kids contract. Florida re-procures these managed care contracts on a multi-year cycle, and regions and specialty designations can change between cycles, so treat plan availability as something to confirm rather than assume.

For autism services, the Florida Medicaid rules are what govern: behavior analysis services require an autism diagnosis, a recommendation from an appropriate treating practitioner, and prior authorization, and must be delivered by a provider enrolled with Florida Medicaid. Speech, occupational and physical therapy are covered when medically necessary. The serious mental illness specialty plan adds care coordination that some families with complex needs find more responsive than a general plan.

If you have Florida Medicaid, you may be able to choose Simply during open enrollment or when you first become eligible. Verify that a provider is in Simply's network specifically — being enrolled with Florida Medicaid is not the same as being contracted with every Medicaid plan.
benefits: Behavior analysis (ABA) coverage under Florida Medicaid rules
Speech, occupational, and physical therapy when medically necessary
Statewide Medicaid availability under the 2025-2030 contracts
Specialty plan options for serious mental illness and for HIV/AIDS
Florida Healthy Kids coverage for children ages 5 through 18
Medicare Advantage plans for eligible members
No-cost or low-cost coverage for eligible Medicaid members
requirements: Florida Medicaid eligibility, Medicare eligibility, or Healthy Kids enrollment
Autism diagnosis required for ASD-specific services
Prior authorization required for behavior analysis and other intensive services
Services must be medically necessary and delivered under an approved treatment plan
Provider must be enrolled with Florida Medicaid AND contracted with Simply
Plan and specialty availability can change between contract cycles - confirm current status
